text:
elaine: Quick alert — canary for the quantized runtime build v2.3.1 is showing a +4% token-level generation error spike on eu-dedicated during tonight's change window. I'm pausing the rollout. @raj can you pin the eu pools back to v2.3.0 and post a status update?

deploy-bot: Canary check FAILED for rollout rl-20260321-09 (runtime-v2.3.1). Action: HOLD.
Suggested commands:
```
# pin model on eu pools
deployctl model-pin --region eu --pool dedicated --model v2.3.0 --reason "canary quantization regressions"
# abort rollout
deployctl rollout-abort --id rl-20260321-09
```

raj: On it — starting pin now, will confirm when traffic flips. ETA ~90s.

raj: Pinned eu-dedicated -> v2.3.0 (commit f1a2b3c). Traffic shifted to pinned model, canary traffic drained.

metrics-bot: Metric alert: generation_error_rate (eu-dedicated) decreased to baseline within 120s after pin.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: model-pin successful. Rollout rl-20260321-09 remains on HOLD.

sasha: Drafting customer-facing copy below — please sanity-check and I can post to Statuspage + email digest. Trying to keep wording minimal and actionable.

sasha: Status page snippet (short):
"We paused a scheduled inference runtime update for EU Dedicated customers after we observed a small increase in generation errors during canary testing. We\u2019ve reverted the EU Dedicated pools to the previous model version (v2.3.0) while we investigate. No customer data was affected and all traffic is serving from the pinned model. We will provide updates here when we have a remediation timeline."

sasha: Email/snippet to affected customers (short):
"Hi — during a routine update we detected a degradation in generation quality in EU Dedicated canaries. We paused the rollout and reverted EU Dedicated pools to the prior model (v2.3.0). Your traffic is now served from the pinned model. We\u2019re investigating and will share an ETA for a safe re-rollout. Contact support if you see anomalies: support@redwood.ai."

elaine: Good. Two quick ops notes: 1) tag the incident with rl-20260321-09 and quantize-regress, 2) schedule an expanded canary with additional eval prompt-set before any reattempt.

andre: Agree on a stricter canary next time. Suggest adding eval checks for hallucination and BLEU-like token divergence + tie threshold to automatic hold.

raj: Filing a follow-up ticket for extended canary tests and adding the eval set — will attach logs and the failing prompts. Ticket: INFRA-4821.

elaine: Who will post the status page update? @sasha? If you post, use the short snippet and add this note: we expect an investigation update within 3 hours.

sasha: I will post now — publishing to EU Dedicated subscribers and adding a link to the incident ledger. Also preparing customer email; queueing for send after a quick legal review.

deploy-bot: Reminder: after pinning, scheduled automated rollbacks for dependent micro-rollouts have been suppressed for 30m to avoid flapping.

raj: Confirming suppression in place.

elaine: Thanks all. Postmortem owners: infra (raj) + applied-ml (andre). Next update in ~2h or earlier if we have root cause. :thumbsup:

sasha: Posted to status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rl-20260321-09 — copy below pasted to the incident body.

-- pasted status body --
We paused a scheduled runtime update for EU Dedicated customers after a small increase in generation errors was detected during canary testing. EU Dedicated pools have been pinned to model v2.3.0. Investigation is underway; we will share findings and an ETA for a safe re-rollout in the next 3 hours.

sasha: I'll also prepare a short FAQ snippet for support: what to expect, how to request immediate re-eval if a customer sees continued issues.

andre: I'll run the additional eval harness and post results in INFRA-4821.

elaine: Closing the loop here — if anyone sees customer incidents that seem related, tag this thread and INFRA-4821.

raj: All good from ops side. Pin complete, suppression active, incident filed.

metrics-bot: Canary monitoring resumed in passive mode; next check in 10m.

elaine: Thanks team.
